reason: Our agents mostly write tests and refactor small things, nothing risky enough to need a pre-change briefing yet. If I touch it at all it's the free self-hosted version on one repo, and I'm not paying for a hosted preview in month one.
objection: Our postmortems sit in a Drive folder nobody opens, so I doubt the memories it builds from them would be any good, and I'm not convinced the agent briefing stops anything a decent code review wouldn't already catch.
would_change_my_mind: An agent change causing a real production incident that a briefing would have flagged, or the team still using the self-hosted version after two weeks without me nagging them.
